title: Bicycles
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig!
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸！

lines.en: Peppa Pig!
Bicycles!
It is a lovely sunny day and Peppa and George are riding their bicycles.
lines.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚的日子，佩奇和乔治正在骑自行车。

lines.en: That's a fine pumpkin, Daddy Pig!
Daddy Pig is very proud of his pumpkin.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸对他的南瓜感到非常自豪。

lines.en: Pumpkins are the only thing I can grow, probably because I love pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 南瓜是我唯一能种的东西，可能是因为我喜欢南瓜派。

lines.en: Come on George!
Daddy, Susie, Rebecca!
Peppa and her friends Danny Dog, Susie Sheep
lines.zh: 佩奇和她的朋友小狗丹尼，小羊苏西

lines.en: and Rebecca Rabbit are riding their bicycles.
lines.zh: 和小兔瑞贝卡正在骑自行车。

lines.en: George is riding his tricycle.
lines.zh: 乔治正在骑着他的三轮车。

lines.en: He's going so slowly!
Let's race to Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 我们一起去猪爸爸的南瓜赛跑吧。

lines.en: If we race to Daddy's pumpkin, we have to be very careful not to bump into it.
lines.zh: 如果我们跑向爸爸的南瓜，我们必须非常小心，不要撞到它。

lines.en: Daddy would be very sad if the pumpkin got broken.
lines.zh: 如果南瓜坏了，爸爸会很难过的。

lines.en: Don't worry Peppa, race you!
Peppa and her friends are racing to Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 佩奇和她的朋友们正在奔向猪爸爸的南瓜。

lines.en: Hey, watch out for my pumpkin!
Peppa, look out! Daddy's pumpkin!
Sorry Daddy.
Look at George, he's going so slowly.
George is still riding a baby bike.
lines.zh: 乔治还在骑婴儿自行车。

lines.en: Yours is a baby bike too Peppa, you've still got stabilizers.
lines.zh: 你的也是一辆婴儿自行车佩奇，你还有稳定器。

lines.en: I can ride without my stabilizers.
lines.zh: 我可以在没有稳定器的情况下骑行。

lines.en: Me too!
And me!
Let's ride up the hill again.
Are you coming Peppa?
No, I think I'll stay here.
See you later!
Bye.
Peppa wishes she did not have stabilizers on her bicycle.
lines.zh: 佩奇希望她的自行车上没有稳定器。

lines.en: Daddy, I don't want stabilizers anymore.
Do you think you can ride without them?
lines.zh: 你认为没有他们你可以骑车吗？

lines.en: Yes!
Alright Peppa, let's take them off.
lines.zh: 好吧，佩奇，我们把它们脱掉吧。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is taking the stabilizers off Peppa's bicycle.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在把佩奇自行车上的稳定器取下来。

lines.en: Are you sure you want to ride without stabilizers?
lines.zh: 您确定要在没有稳定器的情况下骑行吗？

lines.en: Yes!
You've never done it before?
I can do it, I can, I can!
It's not funny!
Riding without stabilizers is not easy.
lines.zh: 没有稳定器的骑行并不容易。

lines.en: Would you like some help Peppa?
Yes please Daddy.
Alright, ready, steady, go!
lines.zh: 好了，准备好了，稳住，出发！

lines.en: Don't let go Daddy.
Don't worry, I've got you.
You're doing really well Peppa.
Hold on Daddy.
Just keep pedaling.
Peppa is riding on her own, without stabilizers.
lines.zh: 佩奇独自骑行，没有稳定器。

lines.en: Daddy, you let go!
You've been cycling on your own for ages.
lines.zh: 你已经独自骑自行车很多年了。

lines.en: Have I?
You're really very good at it.
Am I?
Oh, I can do it.
Look at me, look at me.
I can ride my bike properly.
lines.zh: 我可以正常骑自行车了。

lines.en: Daddy, Suzy, Rebecca, look!
I don't need my stabilizers anymore.
Look at me!
Hurray!
Race you to Daddy's pumpkin!
lines.zh: 带你去爸爸的南瓜赛跑！

lines.en: Peppa, look out, my pumpkin!
I'm going to win!
Peppa isn't looking where she's going.
lines.zh: 佩奇没有看她要去哪里。

lines.en: Oh dear, Peppa has squashed Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
lines.zh: 天哪，佩奇把猪爸爸的南瓜压扁了。

lines.en: Sorry I squashed your pumpkin Daddy.
lines.zh: 对不起，我压碎了你的南瓜爸爸。

lines.en: Never mind the pumpkin.
The important thing is that you are okay.
In future, you really must look where you're going.
lines.zh: 以后，你真的得看看你要去哪里。

lines.en: I promise I will Daddy.
Good.
Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，现在南瓜坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜饼了。

lines.en: I love pumpkin pie!
And because Daddy Pig's pumpkin is so big,
lines.zh: 而且因为猪爸爸的南瓜太大了，

lines.en: there will be enough pumpkin pie for everyone.
lines.zh: 每个人都会有足够的南瓜派。

lines.en: Hurray!
